payload.name: Extract Explicit Naming Rationale
payload.description: Use during extraction when a speaker explains why a pet, object, or person was given a name, such as 'named after...' or 'I named it because...'.
content: During extraction, treat an explicit naming rationale as a distinct fact: capture the named entity, the namesake or reason, and the speaker who provided it.
If the named item already has a memory (e.g., a comfort source), add the naming-origin fact to that memory or create a separate event memory; do not replace or omit the stated rationale.
Record only what the speaker explicitly states about the name's origin and stop once the rationale is captured; do not infer unmentioned reasons.

solves: Extraction captures that an item exists but misses the speaker's explicit explanation of how or why it was named, leaving future name-origin questions unanswerable from memory.
